quote: Aspergillosis, pulmonary and extrapulmonary, in patients who are intolerant of or who are refractory to amphotericin B therapy
note: Pulmonary aspergilloma is a form of the indicated pulmonary aspergillosis.

quote: Septicemia, endocarditis and urinary system infections have been effectively treated with flucytosine.
note: Candida endocarditis is named among the serious Candida infections in the indications section.

quote: During an exacerbation or as maintenance therapy in selected cases of: Systemic lupus erythematosus Acute rheumatic carditis
note: Only acute rheumatic carditis is indicated; generic carditis (any heart-layer inflammation) is a much broader class.

quote: Emergency treatment of allergic reactions (Type I), including anaphylaxis, which may result from allergic reactions to insect stings, biting insects, foods, drugs
note: Anaphylaxis from foods is explicitly covered.

quote: indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection associated with evidence of hepatitis B viral replication
note: Label is chronic hepatitis B only; generic 'hepatitis' spans all etiologies.

quote: management of hypoglycemia due to hyperinsulinism associated with the following conditions: ... Infants and children: Leucine sensitivity, islet cell hyperplasia, nesidioblastosis
note: Congenital hyperinsulinism (nesidioblastosis/islet cell hyperplasia in infants) is a listed hyperinsulinism condition.

quote: indicated for the treatment of acute agitation in schizophrenic adult patients
note: Agitation is the treated condition; schizophrenia is the population.

quote: abnormal uterine bleeding due to hormonal imbalance in the absence of organic pathology, such as fibroids or uterine cancer
note: Uterine cancer is mentioned only as an excluded organic pathology; no endometrial carcinoma indication in text.

quote: reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
note: HeFH explicitly named.

quote: reduction of blood levels and depot stores of lead in lead poisoning (acute and chronic) and lead encephalopathy
note: Lead encephalopathy explicitly indicated.
No sepsis, septicemia or bacteremia indication in the linezolid text.

quote: treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma who received a prior anthracycline-containing regimen
note: Leiomyosarcoma explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of genitourinary tract infections, including acute prostatitis
note: Genitourinary tract infections explicitly indicated.

quote: The naproxen component of naproxen and esomeprazole magnesium delayed-release tablet is indicated for relief of signs and symptoms of: osteoarthritis
note: Osteoarthritis indication belongs to the naproxen component of the combination.

quote: indicated in adults for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Breakthrough pain not named; credited only as a narrower form of the indicated opioid-requiring pain (weak).

quote: indicated for the treatment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) and T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma (T-LBL)
note: Only relapsed/refractory T-ALL is indicated; 'leukemia' is a whole cancer class.

quote: Nicardipine hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of hypertension.
note: Hypertension explicitly indicated.

quote: decrease the incidence of chemotherapy-induced myelosuppression in adult patients when administered prior to a platinum/etoposide-containing regimen ... for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer
note: SCLC is the background setting; the target is chemotherapy-induced myelosuppression.

quote: Difluprednate ophthalmic emulsion is also indicated for the treatment of endogenous anterior uveitis.
note: Anterior uveitis explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism in adult patients with Stage 3 or Stage 4 chronic kidney disease
note: Secondary hyperparathyroidism explicitly indicated.

quote: Severe IBS includes diarrhea and 1 or more of the following: frequent and severe abdominal pain/discomfort, frequent bowel urgency or fecal incontinence
note: Fecal incontinence is only a defining manifestation of severe IBS-D, which is what is treated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of secondary amenorrhea and abnormal uterine bleeding due to hormonal imbalance in the absence of organic pathology
note: Abnormal uterine bleeding explicitly indicated.

quote: Because of the risks of addiction, abuse, misuse, overdose, and death
note: Opioid abuse appears only as a risk/warning, not as an indication.
Indications cover only roundworm and whipworm; hookworm not mentioned.

quote: reduce the risk of myocardial infarction
note: Label is myocardial infarction risk reduction; generic 'Infarction' (any organ) is overbroad.

quote: with hemodynamically significant congenital heart disease (CHD) and who are 24 months of age or younger at the beginning of RSV season
note: CHD defines the population for RSV prophylaxis, not the treated disease.

quote: indicated for the treatment of overactive bladder with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency and frequency
note: Overactive bladder explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients aged 2 years and older with: sickle cell disease (SCD) with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises
note: SCD explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) who are anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody-positive
note: Generalized MG indicated; edge is a near parent.

quote: The treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions (i.e., Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome, systemic mastocytosis, multiple endocrine adenomas)
note: Systemic mastocytosis is a named item in the indicated list.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic
note: Bone pain not named; credited only as a narrower form of indicated severe pain (weak).

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, temporal arteritis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Polymyositis explicitly indicated.

quote: SPINRAZA is indicated for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in pediatric and adult patients.
note: SMA explicitly indicated.

quote: Impetigo contagiosa, superficial folliculitis, ecthyma, furunculosis, sycosis barbae, and pyoderma gangrenosum.
note: Furunculosis listed among primary skin infections.

quote: To reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (CV death, myocardial infarction, stroke, unstable angina requiring hospitalization, or coronary revascularization)
note: MI prevention is explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults
note: Migraine without aura explicitly indicated.

quote: To improve hemodynamic status in patients in distributive shock and shock due to reduced cardiac output
note: Shock due to reduced cardiac output is cardiogenic shock.

quote: tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
note: Tinea pedis listed among indicated ringworm infections.

quote: adjunctive therapy for short-term administration ... in acute gouty arthritis, acute and subacute bursitis
note: Bursitis explicitly listed.

quote: treatment of adult patients with PSMA-positive metastatic androgen pathway modulation-resistant (mAPMR) prostate cancer
note: Only metastatic PSMA-positive prostate cancer indicated; 'cancer' is overbroad.

quote: Severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome)
note: Only erythema multiforme/erythroderma are indicated; edge names the generic sign erythema.

quote: acute lymphoblastic (stem-cell) leukemia (cyclophosphamide given during remission is effective in prolonging its duration)
note: ALL is a listed indicated leukemia.

quote: Treatment of adult patients with very high elevations of serum triglyceride levels (Types IV and V hyperlipidemia) who present a risk of pancreatitis
note: Familial hypertriglyceridemia is a form of the indicated severe hypertriglyceridemia (not the excluded Type I).

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients with rhabdomyosarcoma, as part of a multi-phase, combination chemotherapy regimen
note: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma is a subtype of indicated rhabdomyosarcoma.

quote: acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis; ankylosing spondylitis; psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Multiple arthritides listed; arthritis is a near parent of what is indicated.
